brief: Nomura's McElligott says the equity vol collapse has gone "epic." IWM 3-month ATM implied vol has fallen to the 0.2 percentile, which he reads as dealers absorbing large losses as holders of optionality and skew get bled out. He expects possible headlines on major trading losses crystalizing within days. Equity index vol (z-score) has dropped sharply over two weeks despite spot equities also falling, and August saw twice the realized vol on up days versus down days, both abnormal. He attributes the skew destruction to five simultaneous forces: exotics and structured-note flows forcing dealers long vol and skew into a low-realized, bleed-lower market. The prior buyer of Tech/AI vol has exited while Citadel unwinds its legacy options book, flipping that vol demand to supply. Post-July momentum-unwind retail options and leveraged-ETF activity is drying up, removing the negative-gamma "accelerant" behind past overshoots. Dispersion profitability has cratered to the 5th percentile as single-name vol collapses, forcing QIS derisking. End-users are so netted-down and de-grossed that hedge demand is low, per Goldman's Garrett, pushing SPX put skew to the 2nd percentile. A gated companion note on rates and swaption vol ties back to the "Buyback Bluff" and the yield blowout to multi-year highs.
